_comment: Template connection settings. Fill in your demo credentials, or override with env vars (MT4_LOGIN, MT4_PASSWORD, MT4_SERVER, MT4_SYMBOL, MT4_NAME, MT4_HOST, MT4_PORT, MRPC_API_KEY). The gRPC gateway is host:port (default mt4.mrpc.pro:443; use mt4-stg.mrpc.pro for staging). Do not commit real credentials.
name: rustmt4-examples
